common.checkNetwork: Check your connection and try again.

org.title: Organization settings
org.description: Manage your organization name, branding and public board URL, and maintain the account password.

profile.title: Organization profile
profile.description: Shown across the public board, email notifications and the sign-in page.
profile.footerHint: Apply changes with Save changes in the top-right corner

slug.label: Organization slug
slug.hint: Used for sign-in and public links; it cannot be changed after creation.

logo.label: Logo URL
logo.hint: Leave empty to use the first letter of the name in your brand color.

brandColor.label: Brand color
brandColor.hint: Used as the primary color and brand mark on the public board.

boardUrl.label: Public board URL
boardUrl.hint: Leave empty to use the current domain: https://your-domain/{project slug}
boardUrl.invalid: Enter a full URL starting with http:// or https://

preview.label: Brand preview
preview.caption: Brand shown on the public board and in emails

password.title: Change password
password.description: Sign in with your new password afterwards; sessions on other devices stay active.

next.label: New password
next.hint: At least 8 characters with upper & lower case letters and a number.
next.tooShort: New password must be at least 8 characters
next.weak: Use upper & lower case letters and a number

password.hint: Changing your password requires your current password.

system.title: System configuration
system.description: Configure organization-wide email delivery and attachment storage. Only the owner can make changes.

email.title: Email service
email.description: Sends member invites, status updates and weekly digest emails. Without it, invites become shareable links instead.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.hintMasked: Saved keys appear masked ({{mask}}). Keep it unchanged to retain the current key; enter a new value to replace it.
apiKey.hintUnset: API key for your email provider; stored server-side only.

from.label: Sender email
from.invalid: Enter a valid sender email address

storage.title: File storage
storage.description: Controls where feedback attachments (screenshots, logs) are stored and how they are served publicly.

local.label: Local storage
local.hint: Attachments are stored on the server's local disk; no extra setup required.

s3.label: S3 compatible
s3.hint: Works with AWS S3, MinIO, Cloudflare R2 and other object stores.

qiniu.label: Qiniu Cloud
qiniu.hint: Stores attachments in Qiniu Cloud and serves them through a CDN domain.

localPanel.title: Attachments are stored locally
localPanel.body: Best for self-hosted deployments. Switch to another type to configure a bucket and credentials.

endpoint.label: Endpoint
endpoint.hint: Leave empty when using AWS S3 directly.

cdnDomain.label: CDN domain
cdnDomain.hint: Attachments are served publicly from this domain, e.g. cdn.example.com.

accessKey.label: Access Key
accessKey.hintMasked: Saved keys appear masked ({{mask}}). Keep it unchanged to retain the current key.

secretKey.label: Secret Key
secretKey.hintMasked: Saved keys appear masked ({{mask}}). Keep it unchanged to retain the current key.
secretKey.hintUnset: Object storage secret key; stored server-side only.

project.title: Project settings
project.description: Manage project details, notification policies and single sign-on (SSO).

info.title: Project details
info.description: Basic identifiers and the public access URL.
info.name: Project name
info.copyFailed: Copy failed — select the text and copy it manually

notifications.title: Notification policies
notifications.description: Emails the system sends automatically. Subscribers and opt-outs are managed per project under Notification preferences.

adminNew.title: New feedback notifies admins
adminNew.description: Project admins get an email when feedback arrives from a public channel.

voters.title: Status changes notify voters
voters.description: Voters are emailed when the feedback status changes.

digest.title: Weekly digest
digest.description: A weekly summary of feedback stats and highlights for subscribers.

sso.title: SSO configuration
sso.description: Configure JWT single sign-on. Your host app signs a token and passes it in the X-SSO-Token header.
sso.enabledBody: When enabled, users with a valid X-SSO-Token are signed in automatically and can submit feedback.

jwtSecret.label: JWT Secret
jwtSecret.hintExisting: For security, saved secrets are never echoed back — re-enter the secret to save any change.
jwtSecret.hintNew: Shared secret your host app uses to sign JWTs.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.before: Your host app signs JWTs with this secret; requests pass the token in the
howItWorks.after: header. The system verifies the signature and identifies users automatically, with no separate signup.

deleteModal.title: Delete SSO configuration
deleteModal.description: This cannot be undone. Confirm to continue.
deleteModal.body: Once deleted, single sign-on via X-SSO-Token stops working immediately and the claim mapping is cleared. Users will need to sign in with a password instead.

widget.title: Widget configuration
widget.description: Configure the theme, copy and available fields of the embedded feedback widget. Changes apply after the host page refreshes.

defaults.successMessage: Thanks for your feedback. We'll get back to you soon.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Control the widget's brand color, launcher position and label on your site.

color.label: Primary color
color.hint: Used for the launcher, submit button and success icon.

buttonLabel.label: Button label
buttonLabel.hint: Shown on the floating launcher; 20 characters max.

content.title: Copy & fields
content.description: Customize the success copy and choose which form fields the widget shows.

successTitle.label: Success title
successTitle.hint: Leave empty to use the default title "Feedback submitted".

successMessage.label: Success message
successMessage.hint: Leave empty to use the default message "Thanks for your feedback. We'll get back to you soon."
successMessage.placeholder: Thanks for your feedback. We'll get back to you soon.

category.label: Category selector
category.description: Let users choose a category for their feedback

priority.label: Priority selector
priority.description: Let users pick a priority when submitting

contact.label: Contact field
contact.description: Collect an email or phone number for follow-ups

preview.title: Live preview
preview.description: Matches how the widget looks on your site

embed.title: Embed code
embed.description: Paste the snippet before the </body> tag on your site; refresh the host page after saving to apply it. The widget fetches the latest configuration automatically.
embed.apiKeyHintBefore: Copy the API Key from the

preview.title: Email template preview
preview.description: Pick an email type to preview what recipients actually receive. Sample data is never sent.
preview.errorDescription: Check your connection and try again.
